sections.What we use it for:
The `features:` and `palette:` blocks in `mkdocs.yml` are this theme's. They put each section's index page behind the section name, offer an edit pencil on every page, and let the reader's own light or dark setting decide, with a toggle either way.

It is pinned beside MkDocs in `docs/requirements.txt`, so a theme release changes the site when we take it rather than on its own.
